one_line: An anime-style personification of the king named on the eastern pillar inscription of Mauryan India.

appearance.age_look: late 20s, lean but athletic build, average height
appearance.face: oval face with straight nose, warm medium-brown complexion, sharp dark eyes with slightly thick brows, a small tilak-like mark on the forehead, default expression calm and thoughtful with a hint of stern authority
appearance.hair: smooth black hair gathered neatly into a high topknot at the back of the crown, front hair pulled back cleanly with no loose fringe, held by a simple dark brown wooden hairpin and a thin gold circlet resting low on the forehead
appearance.costume: Mauryan-era northern Indian court attire: a knee-length off‑white cotton tunic with half sleeves and a subtle woven border, worn over fitted light-cream trousers; a rich deep-red cotton‑silk angavastra (shawl) draped from the left shoulder across the chest and wrapped once around the waist, its edges decorated with narrow gold and dark-green geometric borders; a simple brown waistbelt securing the shawl; plain dark-brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery—thin gold bangles on each wrist and a single small gold stud in each ear, all kept modest to reflect an early imperial court style.
appearance.signature: A smooth sandstone royal pillar fragment held vertically in his right hand, about chest‑height, cylindrical with a slightly flared top and faint incised Brahmi‑like characters, its surface weathered but polished along one side.

ref_desc: The Eastern Pillar King is a lean late‑20s man with medium‑brown skin, black hair in a high topknot with a thin gold circlet, wearing an off‑white tunic, cream trousers, deep‑red bordered angavastra, brown sandals, gold bangles, and holding a sandstone pillar fragment with faint script.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime model sheet of a lean late‑20s Mauryan‑era Indian king with medium‑brown skin, an oval face, sharp dark eyes, a small forehead mark, and calm, thoughtful authority; his smooth black hair is pulled back into a high topknot secured by a dark brown wooden hairpin and encircled by a thin gold circlet resting low on the forehead; he wears a knee‑length off‑white cotton tunic with half sleeves and a subtle woven border over fitted light‑cream trousers, with a rich deep‑red cotton‑silk angavastra draped from his left shoulder across the chest and wrapped once around the waist, its edges trimmed with narrow gold and dark‑green geometric borders, all secured by a simple brown waistbelt; his feet are in plain dark‑brown leather sandals, and he has minimal jewellery—thin gold bangles on each wrist and small gold studs in each ear; in his right hand he holds a chest‑high smooth sandstone pillar fragment, cylindrical with a slightly flared top and faint incised script, its surface weathered but polished along one side; use a palette of off‑white, deep red, gold, dark brown, and medium‑brown skin tones, and present him from multiple angles to clearly show hair, face, costume details, and the pillar fragment prop.
